assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough) derived from the announcement text and area constraints in brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers and metrics must be recomputed when official polygons are published. Precision limits are disclosed in proposal.md, visual/index.html, and self_check.json. Organizer data gaps do not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition in geometry/land_use.geojson is a concept proposal covering the submitted boundary without gaps or overlaps; statutory land use, FAR, height, density, setback, and green-ratio controls remain pending official regulatory conditions.
assumptions.impact: Land-use shares and areas in metrics.json are recomputable from submitted geometry but must not be read as approved regulatory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual massing indicators (16 footprints, ~30.1 ha); storey counts, heights, and retain/renovate/demolish conclusions require official building stock, ownership, and regulatory conditions.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_count are design-layer metrics only, not approved construction scale.

assumptions.statement: Road and slow-traffic corridors are conceptual route organization; road redlines, cross-sections, station integration, parking, and non-motorized traffic conditions require official transport studies.
assumptions.impact: road_centerline_length_m reflects concept corridors only; no engineering alignment claims are made.

assumptions.statement: Green and public space layouts are conceptual; river blue lines, green ratios, heritage protection ranges, and municipal safety conditions require official confirmation.
assumptions.impact: green_ratio, public_space_ratio, green_space_area_sqm, and public_space_area_sqm are derived from concept geometry and will be recomputed after official data release.

assumptions.statement: Phasing zones are conceptual implementation sequences; development timing, investment, and approval paths require ownership and regulatory confirmation.
assumptions.impact: phase_count and phasing areas are concept metrics; no implementation commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: Performance metrics (ai_innovation_index, talent_density, green_space_per_capita_sqm) require official industry, population, and service-facility statistics for calibration.
assumptions.impact: These metrics remain status=unknown until official data is available; they are not fabricated.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, pilgrimage landmarks, honor-display systems, annual events, community operations, and conversion pathways are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; they are not approved government arrangements or implementation commitments.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards, landmarks, and operations are design-communication content, not statutory or contractual commitments.
